name: Deathstalker Rane Yorick
summary: Deathstalker Rane Yorick is an operative of the Forsaken intelligence guild stationed deep in Silverpine Forest. Together with her brother Quinn, she was sent to scout the farms of northern Silverpine and report to High Executor Hadrec.

sections.title: Eyes in the Woods
sections.body: The Deathstalkers serve as Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's eyes, ears, and blades across Lordaeron. Operating out of shadows and hidden posts, agents like Rane Yorick monitor the wilderness for threats that could disrupt Forsaken dominion. When sent to scout northern Silverpine Forest, Rane and her brother Quinn found themselves hemmed in by surrounding feral dangers, turning an undercover reconnaissance mission into a battle for survival.

sections.title: Trapped at Ivar Patch
sections.body: Holed up inside a derelict farmhouse at the Ivar Patch, Rane Yorick finds her mission compromised. The ghoul Ivar the Foul has badly mauled her brother Quinn, and worgs roam the fields between her and the safety of the Sepulcher. Rather than abandon her assignment, she relies on passing Horde travelers to gather worg hearts for a healing potion, slay Ivar, and deliver her report back to command.

faq.answer: She is an operative of the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken rogue order of assassins and intelligence gatherers. She is currently stationed at a dilapidated farmhouse at the Ivar Patch in Silverpine Forest.
The Deathstalkers are the clandestine rogue guild of the Forsaken, answering to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. They carry out covert scouting, espionage, and targeted assassinations across Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why is she trapped in a farmhouse?
faq.answer: Rane and her brother Quinn were sent to scout the farms of northern Silverpine Forest, but the ghoul Ivar the Foul attacked them at the Ivar Patch and badly mauled Quinn, forcing them to hole up in the farmhouse while he heals.
Her brother is Quinn Yorick, a fellow Deathstalker on the same reconnaissance mission, who was badly mauled by the ghoul Ivar the Foul at the Ivar Patch.

faq.q: What threats are they tracking in Silverpine?
faq.answer: Their mission was to scout the farms of northern Silverpine for threats to the Forsaken occupation. They found a far heavier Scourge presence than expected, along with prowling worgs and the ghoul Ivar the Foul.

faq.q: Where does she report her findings?
faq.answer: She reports to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher, who oversees the Forsaken occupation of Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: For Forsaken rogues, Rane Yorick exemplifies the perilous fieldwork expected of the Deathstalkers, maintaining stealth and collecting intelligence under constant enemy pressure.
Forsaken champions encounter Rane as a frontline scout keeping the untamed frontier of Silverpine Forest from falling back into hostile hands.
Her intelligence operations help ensure Horde supply routes running through Silverpine remain clear of worgen and local ambushes.
